2. entity["hotel","Hampton Inn Tampa/Rocky Point-Airport","Tampa, FL, USA | 3035 N Rocky Point Dr E"]
   *Typically:* **$99 to $140/night**
   *Pros:* Free breakfast, free airport shuttle, free parking. Usually the best value if you only need a standard hotel room. citeturn0search2

3. entity["turn0business1","DoubleTree by Hilton Tampa Rocky Point Waterfront"]

4. entity["hotel","The CURRENT Hotel, Autograph Collection","Tampa, FL, USA | 2545 N Rocky Point Dr"]

5. entity["hotel","The Westin Tampa Bay","Tampa, FL, USA | 7627 W Courtney Campbell Cswy"]
